name: Low FODMAP Trail Mix
ingredients:
200 g roasted salted peanuts (plain, no honey or chilli)
130 g walnut halves
100 g pecan halves
130 g macadamias (plain or lightly salted)
100 g hulled pumpkin seeds (pepitas), plain roasted
80 g gluten-free corn flakes or certified GF puffed rice (corn or rice, sugar and salt only — no honey, inulin, or barley malt)

To pack
16 small snack bags

Optional, camp evenings only (melts on the boat)
60 g dark chocolate 70%+, no milk
directions:
1. Tip the peanuts, walnuts, pecans, macadamias, pumpkin seeds, and GF corn flakes or puffed rice into a large bowl. Toss until even.

2. Weigh 40 g into each of 16 snack bags. One bag is one snack.

3. Eat at most two bags a day so the low-FODMAP nut serves do not stack.

4. Keep dark chocolate in a separate bag for camp only — it will melt on the kayak.

5. Keep biltong or jerky out of the mix (moisture). Do not add popcorn; it crushes and goes rancid in the heat.
notes:
Shopping (buy these amounts; some leftover nuts are spare snacks):
- Roasted salted peanuts 200 g (use all)
- Walnut halves 150 g (use 130 g)
- Pecan halves 100 g (use all)
- Macadamias 150 g (use 130 g)
- Hulled pumpkin seeds 100 g (use all)
- GF corn flakes or GF puffed rice 80 g (use all)
- 16 small snack bags

Do not buy: cashews, pistachios, almonds, raisins, any dried fruit, honey-roast, yogurt-coated, regular Rice Krispies.

Yield is about 740 g mix → 16 × 40 g bags (2 snacks a day for 8 days).
